scenes.voiceover: Success doesn't come overnight. It's built, one small step at a time.
scenes.visual_description: A sunrise over a quiet city. A person waking up and stretching.

scenes.voiceover: Each morning you rise, you're given a new opportunity to grow.
scenes.visual_description: Person brushing teeth, putting on workout gear.

scenes.voiceover: Consistency means showing up, even when you don't feel like it.
scenes.visual_description: Clips of the person working out, reading a book, or coding.

scenes.voiceover: At first, the progress may seem invisible. But every action adds up.
scenes.visual_description: Calendar flipping pages, a graph slowly going upward.

scenes.voiceover: And one day, you'll look back and see how far you've come.
scenes.visual_description: Person receiving an award, launching a project, or crossing a finish line.

scenes.voiceover: Stay consistent. Your future self is already proud of you.
scenes.visual_description: Person smiling, looking at their reflection. Fade to a motivational quote.

closing_quote.text: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
closing_quote.author: Robert Collier
